blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY – Police have tightened security around schools across Eastern Visayas after discovering a threat letter at the Biliran Province State University (BiPSU) campus in Naval. This development came as authorities remain on heightened alert over campus violence following recent school shootings in Tacloban City and South Cotabato. READ: Online threats put Eastern Samar, Samar schools on heightened alert Authorities found the threat letter inside the BiPSU Student Center on Tuesday, prompting the university’s Crisis Management Team, Naval Municipal Police Station (MPS), and the Biliran Police Provincial Office to respond and conduct a security assessment.
